title: 101. Kth Largest Element in a Stream

examples.explanation: The function returns the third largest value after each insertion.
With k = 1, each answer is the maximum value seen so far.

hints: Keep only the k largest values seen so far.
A min-heap of size k exposes the current kth largest value at its root.
Insert each value, remove the heap minimum when its size exceeds k, and record the root after every addition.
